newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MAZHEIKIU STARTS DIESEL EXPORT VIA KLAIPEDA.
newsitem.headline: MAZHEIKIU STARTS DIESEL EXPORT VIA KLAIPEDA.

text.p: Lithuanian oil refinery Mazheikiu Nafta said on Monday it started the export of diesel fuel via Klaipeda port.

"Mazheikiu Nafta sent its first volume of ecologically clean diesel fuel with 0.05 percent of sulphur to be exported via Klaipeda port today," company spokeswoman Virginija Kristinaitiene told Reuters.

"We have signed an agreemnet to export monthly up to 50,000 tonnes of diesel fuel with 0.05 percent sulphur with Klaipedos Nafta oil terminal although the concrete volume will be agreed each month ," Kristinaitiene said.
Kristinaitiene said that Klaipedos Nafta offered more favourable terms to Mazheikiu Nafta than Venspils port.
She also said that Mazheikiu Nafta would continue the export of diesel fuel with 0.2 percent suplhur and jet fuel via Ventspils.

"Venspils can serve tankers with 80,000 tonnes capacity while Klaipeda port can accept tankers with 30,000 tonnes capacity and there were rumours that Ventspils might also offer a price reduction," Kristinaitiene added.
